description: This file defines the ApiException class within the SuiteCRM project. It extends the LangException class and provides mechanisms for handling API-related exceptions, including setting detailed messages, source information, and HTTP status codes.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: A specialized exception class for API errors in SuiteCRM, providing structured error information, including message prefix, source details, and HTTP status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ApiException with an optional message, code, previous exception, and language message.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about the cause of the exception, returning a LangText object.

methods.name: setDetail
methods.description: Sets additional detail information about the exception using a LangText object.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source of the error, either as a string pointer or as an array with pointer and parameter keys.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source information array for the exception.

methods.name: getHttpStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with this exception, which is 500.
